title: 约束获取需要更好的基准测试
summary: 当前约束获取（CA）研究因缺乏合适的基准测试而受限，影响可重复性和可比性。本文提出MPMMine基准套件，通过统一结构、开放格式（MiniZinc、CommonMark、JSON）和版本控制，提供多模型、多实例及自然语言描述，以支持CA算法评估。
summary_en: Constraint Acquisition research is hindered by inadequate benchmarks. This paper introduces MPMMine, a benchmark suite with uniform structure, open formats, and version control, providing multiple models, instances, and natural-language descriptions to evaluate CA algorithms.
